narration.text: [low, measured, serious] For three nights, a tall man watched a lonely house from the trees. [pause] Tonight, he would take the boy inside. He knew when the lights went out. He knew when the dogs slept.
[quieter] In the dark, he cut the phone line.

[slow, hushed] At midnight, he climbed through a window. Two men slept upstairs. In the basement, a small boy lay alone. [almost whispering] He crossed the room without a sound. He put his hand over the boy's mouth and lifted him.
[flat, matter-of-fact] On the way out, he locked the two men inside their room.

[urgent, breathless] He ran across the dark field with the boy in his arms. Police cars waited at the road. [pause] [calm, certain] He had called them. Five days ago, those men took the boy from school. [warm, slow, gentle] The boy held him tight and whispered, [whispers] "Papa."
